doc: A quarter of the field (the 16x16 corner) is exactly 0 (an open cell's empty center): the 256 equal texels take ONE mean rank, hence one byte, never a ramp down the rows. The plateau is the lowest value, mean rank 127.5 of 1024 texels: byte 31. Ranks are integers in float64 arithmetic: byte = floor(rank * 256 / n) with the MEAN rank of equal values; byte output: exact.
